title: Choose the visual world for Growing Minds Science
question: Re-roll round 2, steered: calm and inviting, collegiate and respectable, no orange as the main colour. The roll assigned The Terrain. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: The Terrain
options.lineage: the survey map: contour lines, woodland, water, and a waymarked route across the first five years
options.thesis: Development is terrain, not a line: the page is one survey sheet of the first five years, the wide normal range drawn as valleys and ridges, and each class a waymarked route through its stretch.
options.viewport: A full-bleed survey sheet. Slate contour lines sweep across the whole viewport over map-white, with two sage woodland patches and one pale stream. A single teal route runs left to right through the sheet with four waymarks, one per class, and grid-reference numerals at the top edge mark birth to five. The headline sits upper left in a confident grotesk, with the lede and a square navy action beneath. Along the foot, the map margin is the legend: four route segments, each a class with its ages, lessons and price, the active one drawn solid.
options.risk: A map can read as a hiking brand; every contour must mean something developmental (the valley is the normal range, the ridge is a window), and the route must carry the classes, not decorate them.

raised.raise: State is a mark, not a hue: a finished class is a struck waymark, the class you are in is a flag, and nothing relies on colour alone.
One restricted ink set on every surface and one abstract mark per class, so the inner pages print from the same sheet.
The headline is set as matter at monumental scale, not as a caption on the map.
One shared order leads through everything: the single route line is the page's and the site's wayfinding.
The sheet stays whole at every size while the panels restack around it; phones never get a cropped map.

options.label: The Botanical Plate
options.lineage: the botanical growth plate: a seedling drawn at its stages with numbered parts, deep green on a white sheet
options.thesis: Growing Minds, literally: the brand's sprouting mark becomes a scientific growth plate, five stages of one seedling with numbered parts, and each class is the plate for its stage.
options.viewport: The left half is a white sheet carrying the headline in a grotesk at seven vw, the lede, and a square deep-green action. The right half is one solid botanical-green field holding Plate 1: a seedling drawn in fine white line at five stages, root to leaf, with numbered callouts that name what is growing (cues, words, autonomy, pretend play, self-control). A thin caption row under the field reads like a plate caption: Fig. 1, the first five years. The four classes run as Plates 1 to 4 down the page.
options.case: The name and the logo already say it; a growth plate is calm, collegiate, and the one scientific picture every parent finds inviting.
options.risk: Also where a strong run in this category lands: a botanical motif slides into wallpaper fast. It holds only if the drawings are real plates with named parts, never decoration.

options.label: The Pattern Sheet
options.lineage: a home sewing pattern: views lettered on the envelope, nested size lines on the tissue, numbered pieces, a cutting layout
options.thesis: A class is a pattern you follow: ages are nested size lines, your child's age is the one drawn solid, and the four classes are views A to D on the envelope.
options.viewport: A pale drafting-tissue ground covered in dashed nested outlines of a child figure at five sizes, birth to five, with notches and grain arrows. The size for 1 to 3 is drawn solid in teal. The headline sits top left in a grotesk; views A, B, C, D run as a lettered strip down the right edge, one per class with its name and price. The action is a square navy button under the lede.
options.case: Holds clarity: nested sizes are a true picture of ages, and a numbered plan is exactly what a class is. Loses identification: few parents today know the tissue by heart, and the manila ground is translated to cool tissue to honour the steer.
options.risk: Charming on the first screen, hard to sustain through a FAQ and a chat demo without turning into decoration.

options.label: The Minihompy
options.thesis: Identity as a room you decorate.
options.viewport: An isometric room with panels around it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nostalgia for a social network the audience never used, and pastel is the brief's anti-reference.
options.kept: The scene stays whole at every size while panels restack around it.

options.label: The Cutting Bench
options.lineage: a film cutting bench flattened into a sheet
options.thesis: A perforated rail, frames between pins, a tape flag where you stopped.
options.viewport: A rail crossing a black field at fixed height.
options.case: Fuses poorly: orange on black is exactly what the steer refuses, and editing film is nobody's parenting scene.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: The Alphabet Storm
options.lineage: letters condensing into weather on a white field
options.case: Fuses poorly: a page that storms is the opposite of calm, and the offer vanishes in the weather.
options.kept: One monumental grotesk behaving as matter.

options.label: The Kiosk Print
options.lineage: state-kiosk printed goods sharing three inks
options.thesis: Three permitted inks, one office mark per product, no photographs.
options.viewport: A kiosk grid of product cells.
options.case: Fuses weakly: the restricted palette is calm and respectable, but a grid with no photographs cannot carry the classes' real imagery.
options.kept: One restricted ink set everywhere and one abstract mark per class.

options.label: The Sign River
options.lineage: a night-market river of lanterns and painted boards
options.thesis: A river of lanterns is the only shared order.
options.viewport: Lanterns bending past awnings through steam.
options.case: Fuses poorly: saffron on black is loud and warm where the steer asks for calm, and the clamor hides the offer.
options.kept: One shared order leads through every district.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What parenting-class sites ship, executed impeccably: a warm photograph, a rounded teal button, three proof cards.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and lede left, a rounded photograph of a parent and child right, two pill buttons, three icon cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other parenting course by design.
